genxml.title: Hub memory and directory register layouts and constants outside the census
genxml.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header, pinned linux tree (field masks, shifts and default constants)

struct.name: MD_MEM_DIMM_INIT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header, pinned linux tree: MD_MEM_DIMM_INIT (offset and name)
struct.doc: Memory DIMM mode initialisation. Layout in the MD_DIMM_INIT_FORMAT word. The header gives no access type, so rw is assumed.

struct.name: MD_DIR_DIMM_INIT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header, pinned linux tree: MD_DIR_DIMM_INIT (offset and name)
struct.doc: Directory DIMM mode initialisation. Same layout as the memory register. The header gives no access type, so rw is assumed.

struct.name: MD_LED1
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header, pinned linux tree: MD_LED1 (offset, name and the description eight-bit LED for the second processor)
struct.doc: Eight-bit LED of the second processor, the twin of md_led0 in the census. The header gives no access type; write-only is carried over from md_led0 and is inferred.

struct.name: MD_DIMM_INIT_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header: MDI_* masks
struct.doc: Layout of the memory and directory DIMM mode initialisation registers. Both registers share this layout.

struct.name: MD_DIR_ERROR_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header: dir_error_reg structure
struct.doc: Layout of the directory error latch, from the header's structure. The header lists the fields from the most significant bit down and gives a comment for each range. Bit positions here follow those comments.

struct.name: MD_MEMORY_CONFIG_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header: MD_MEMORY_CONFIG fields (MMC_*)
struct.doc: Layout of the memory configuration register. Bank descriptors take bits 23:0, three bits each. The timing fields and the bank-size codes are named by the header, and their meaning is only partly stated there.

struct.name: MD_MEM_ERROR_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header: mem_error_reg structure
struct.doc: Layout of the memory error latch, from the header's structure.

struct.name: MD_MIG_CANDIDATE_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header: MD_MIG_CANDIDATE masks
struct.doc: Layout of the page migration candidate. The header's initiator and node-number masks overlap at bits 28:20, so only the single-bit fields are imported here. The shipped IRIX kernel reads only the read-to-clear alias (md_mig_candidate_clr), in a loop until the valid bit is clear, and takes the node and page fields below from it. That a read consumes the candidate is inferred from the register name and the loop. Nothing in the kernel accesses the candidate register itself, which sits one doubleword below the alias.

field.name: node
field.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header: MD_MIG_CANDIDATE_NODEID_MASK (0x1ff at shift 20)

field.name: page
field.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header: MD_MIG_CANDIDATE_ADDR_MASK (0x3ffff)

struct.name: MD_MIG_THRESH_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header: MD_MIG_DIFF_THRES and MD_MIG_VALUE_THRES masks
struct.doc: Layout of the page migration difference and value thresholds. The two registers share this layout. The shipped IRIX kernel arms a threshold by setting the valid bit (bit 63) and clears the bit to disarm it while a candidate is handled.

struct.name: MD_MISC_ERROR_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header: MMCE_* masks
struct.doc: Layout of the miscellaneous error latch. The header's valid mask covers bits 9:0. Its long-pack mask is written with a misspelt shift macro, so only the other masks are imported as stated.

struct.name: MD_MLAN_CTL_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header: MD_MLAN_CTL fields (MLAN_*)
struct.doc: Layout of the one-wire (Microlan) control register.

struct.name: MD_MOQ_SIZE_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header: MD_MOQ_SIZE fields (MMS_*)
struct.doc: Layout of the outgoing queue size register.

struct.name: MD_PERF_CNT_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header: md_perf_cnt_t structure
struct.doc: Layout of performance counters 0 to 5. Bit positions come from the header's structure, read in the same order as the select register and so inferred.

struct.name: MD_PERF_SEL_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header: md_perf_sel_t structure
struct.doc: Layout of the performance counter select register. Bit positions come from the header's structure, which lists the fields from the most significant bit down. The order is taken as written there and is inferred.

struct.name: MD_PROTOCOL_ERROR_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header: proto_error_reg structure
struct.doc: Layout of the protocol error latch, from the header's structure.

struct.name: MD_REFRESH_CONTROL_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header: MD_REFRESH_CONTROL fields (MRC_*)
struct.doc: Layout of the refresh control register.

struct.name: MD_SLOTID_USTAT_FORMAT
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub memory/directory header: MD_SLOTID_USTAT fields (MSU_*)
struct.doc: Layout of the slot identity and status register. The header also defines an SN00 slot bit at bit 7 and a PIMM field at 7:4. Both overlap bits named here, so they are left out.
